Sip&Pop

Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 14, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Ayran Studio ("we", "us", or "our") handles information when you play Sip&Pop. We aim to process personal data openly and in accordance with applicable data-protection law, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) where it applies.

Data controller

The controller responsible for the processing described in this policy is Furkan Selek, operating as Ayran Studio.
Address: M. Fevzi Çakmak Mah., 35445 Urla, İzmir, Türkiye
Email: contact@ayranstudio.com
Privacy requests: privacy@ayranstudio.com

Information we process

Sip&Pop does not require an account. Ayran Studio does not ask for or directly collect your name, email address, or contacts through the game.

Information stored on your device

Sip&Pop stores game progress and preferences locally on your device, including completed levels, earned stars, lives and their recovery time, daily-order progress, language, and sound settings. This information is used to run the game, restore your progress, and remember your choices. Ayran Studio does not receive this local save data.

Optional gameplay analytics

If you choose to allow usage analytics in the game, Sip&Pop uses Google Analytics for Firebase to process gameplay events such as level starts and results, scores, moves remaining, daily rewards, and rewarded-ad continues. Firebase may also process app-instance identifiers, device and app information, approximate location inferred from IP, and diagnostics. We use this information to understand level difficulty, detect progression problems, and improve the game. We do not attach your name, email address, or contacts to these events. Analytics is disabled until you make a choice, and you can change that choice at any time under Privacy & analytics in the main menu.

Advertising and third-party services

Sip&Pop offers optional rewarded advertisements through Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). If you choose to watch an ad, Google and its partners may automatically process information such as device and advertising identifiers, IP address, approximate location inferred from IP, device and app information, diagnostics, and ad views or interactions. They use this information to deliver and measure ads, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations. The exact data processed can depend on your device, region, consent choices, and Google's configuration.

Learn more in the Google Privacy Policy and on How Google uses information for advertising.

Purposes and legal bases

Where the GDPR applies, we rely on your consent for optional gameplay analytics and for personalized advertising. Analytics remains disabled unless you allow it. If you decline personalized advertising, Google may still serve limited or non-personalized ads where permitted. Where applicable, we rely on our legitimate interests to operate and secure the game, measure basic service performance, prevent fraud, and resolve technical problems, provided those interests do not override your rights. We may also process information when necessary to meet a legal obligation.

Consent management and your choices

Where required, Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) presents advertising choices before the game requests its first ad. You can accept, decline, or manage the available purposes and partners. The game requests an ad only after UMP reports that advertising is permitted. You can reopen Google's choices from Privacy & analytics → Ad privacy choices in the main menu whenever Google requires that option to be available.

Gameplay analytics has a separate in-game choice and can be enabled or disabled at any time from the same Privacy & analytics menu. You may also decline any rewarded ad; in that case, the related in-game reward is not granted. Your device may provide additional advertising-ID and privacy controls. You can remove local game data by clearing Sip&Pop's app storage or uninstalling the game.

How information is used and shared

Local game data is used only to provide gameplay and save your settings. If you allow analytics, Google processes the analytics data described above on our behalf. Advertising data may be processed and shared by Google and its advertising partners as described in their policies. Ayran Studio does not sell personal information.

Retention and international transfers

Your local game data and analytics preference remain on your device until you clear Sip&Pop's app data or uninstall the game. Information processed by Google is retained according to our service configuration, Google's retention rules, and applicable law. Google and its partners may process information outside your country; where required, they use recognized safeguards for international transfers. Because Sip&Pop has no player accounts, we may need information such as an app-instance identifier to locate provider-held data connected with a request.

Security

We limit the game's data use to what is needed for gameplay and the optional analytics and advertising services. No method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure, but we and our service providers use reasonable safeguards appropriate to the information processed.

Children's privacy

Sip&Pop is intended for a general audience and is not specifically directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly ask children under 16 to provide personal information directly to Ayran Studio. A parent or guardian who believes a child has provided personal information without appropriate consent may contact us so we can review and, where applicable, delete it.

Your data-protection rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, erase, restrict, or receive a portable copy of your personal data, and to object to certain processing. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting processing that occurred before withdrawal. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority. To exercise a right, email privacy@ayranstudio.com. We may ask for enough information to verify and locate the relevant data.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when Sip&Pop, its services, or legal requirements change. We will post the revised policy here and update the effective date.
